public class Task939F {

    private static int n, k, numRotates, minNumRotates;
    private static int[] kbeg, kend;

        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        kbeg = new int[k];
        kend = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            kbeg[i] = sc.nextInt();
            kend[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        sc.close();

        int[] tmin = new int[2];
        int[] tmax = new int[2];
        numRotates = 0;
        minNumRotates = 0;

        calcRotates(0, tmin, tmax, 0, 0, false);

        if (minNumRotates > 0) {
            System.out.println("Full");
            System.out.println(minNumRotates);
        } else {
            System.out.println("Hungry");
        }
    }

    private static void saveRotates(int num) {
        if (minNumRotates == 0) minNumRotates = num;
        else minNumRotates = Math.min(minNumRotates, num);
    }

    private static void calcRotates(int side, int[] tmin, int[] tmax,
                                    int noffset, int koffset, boolean isInterval) {
        if (tmin[0] > n || tmin[1] > n) return;
        if ((tmin[0] <= n && tmax[0] >= n) || (tmin[1] <= n && tmax[1] >= n)) {
            if ((tmax[0] < n && side == 1) || (tmax[1] < n && side == 0)) {
                saveRotates(numRotates + 1);
            } else {
                saveRotates(numRotates);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (koffset == k) return;

        if (isInterval) {
            if (kbeg[koffset] == kend[koffset]) {
                // no rotate
                calcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false);
                // rotate
                numRotates++;
                calcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false);
                numRotates--;
            } else {
                // no rotate
                tmin[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                calcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
                tmin[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];

                // rotate once
                tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                tmax[1 - side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                numRotates++;
                calcRotates(1 - side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
                numRotates--;
                tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                tmax[1 - side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];

                // rotate twice
                tmax[side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                tmin[1 - side] += 1;
                tmax[1 - side] += kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset] - 1;
                numRotates += 2;
                calcRotates(side, tmin, tmax, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false);
                numRotates -= 2;
                tmax[side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                tmin[1 - side] -= 1;
                tmax[1 - side] -= kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset] - 1;
            }
        } else {
            tmin[side] += kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
            tmax[side] += kbeg[koffset] - noffset;

        else minRotates = Math.min(minRotates, val);
    }

    private static void solve(int side, int[] lo, int[] hi,
                              int offset, int idx, boolean inside) {

            if ((hi[0] < N && side == 1) || (hi[1] < N && side == 0)) {
                update(rotates + 1);

                update(rotates);
            }
            return;

            if (start[idx] == end[idx]) {
                solve(side, lo, hi, offset, idx + 1, false);
                rotates++;
                solve(1 - side, lo, hi, offset, idx + 1, false);
                rotates--;

                // no rotate
                lo[side] += end[idx] - start[idx];
                hi[side] += end[idx] - start[idx];
                solve(side, lo, hi, end[idx], idx + 1, false);
                lo[side] -= end[idx] - start[idx];
                hi[side] -= end[idx] - start[idx];

                hi[1 - side] += end[idx] - start[idx];
                rotates++;

                rotates--;
                hi[side] -= end[idx] - start[idx];
                hi[1 - side] -= end[idx] - start[idx];

            hi[side] += start[idx] - offset;

            lo[side] -= start[idx] - offset;
            hi[side] -= start[idx] - offset;

            kend[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        minRotates = 0;
        Deque<State> stack = new ArrayDeque<>();
        stack.push(new State(0, new int[]{0,0}, new int[]{0,0}, 0, 0, false, 0));

        while (!stack.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = stack.pop();
            int side = cur.side;
            int[] tmin = cur.tmin;
            int[] tmax = cur.tmax;
            int noffset = cur.noffset;
            int koffset = cur.koffset;
            boolean isInterval = cur.isInterval;
            int numRotates = cur.numRotates;

            if (tmin[0] > n || tmin[1] > n) continue;
            if ((tmin[0] <= n && tmax[0] >= n) || (tmin[1] <= n && tmax[1] >= n)) {
                int val;
                if ((tmax[0] < n && side == 1) || (tmax[1] < n && side == 0)) {
                    val = numRotates + 1;
                } else {
                    val = numRotates;
                }
                if (minRotates == 0) minRotates = val;
                else minRotates = Math.min(minRotates, val);
                continue;
            }
            if (koffset == k) continue;

            if (isInterval) {
                if (kbeg[koffset] == kend[koffset]) {
                    // no rotate
                    stack.push(new State(side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false, numRotates));
                    // rotate
                    stack.push(new State(1 - side, tmin, tmax, noffset, koffset + 1, false, numRotates + 1));
                } else {
                    int diff = kend[koffset] - kbeg[koffset];
                    // no rotate
                    int[] tmin1 = tmin.clone();
                    int[] tmax1 = tmax.clone();
                    tmin1[side] += diff;
                    tmax1[side] += diff;
                    stack.push(new State(side, tmin1, tmax1, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false, numRotates));

                    // rotate once
                    int[] tmin2 = tmin.clone();
                    int[] tmax2 = tmax.clone();
                    tmax2[side] += diff;
                    tmax2[1 - side] += diff;
                    stack.push(new State(1 - side, tmin2, tmax2, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false, numRotates + 1));

                    // rotate twice
                    int[] tmin3 = tmin.clone();
                    int[] tmax3 = tmax.clone();
                    tmax3[side] += diff;
                    tmin3[1 - side] += 1;
                    tmax3[1 - side] += diff - 1;
                    stack.push(new State(side, tmin3, tmax3, kend[koffset], koffset + 1, false, numRotates + 2));
                }
            } else {
                int diff = kbeg[koffset] - noffset;
                int[] tmin4 = tmin.clone();
                int[] tmax4 = tmax.clone();
                tmin4[side] += diff;
                tmax4[side] += diff;
                stack.push(new State(side, tmin4, tmax4, kbeg[koffset], koffset, true, numRotates));
            }
        }

        if (minRotates > 0) {
            System.out.println("Full");
            System.out.println(minRotates);
        } else {
            System.out.println("Hungry");
        }
    }

    private static class State {
        int side;
        int[] tmin, tmax;
        int noffset, koffset;
        boolean isInterval;
        int numRotates;

        State(int side, int[] tmin, int[] tmax, int noffset, int koffset, boolean isInterval, int numRotates) {
            this.side = side;
            this.tmin = tmin;
            this.tmax = tmax;
            this.noffset = noffset;
            this.koffset = koffset;
            this.isInterval = isInterval;
            this.numRotates = numRotates;
        }
    }

    // FastScanner unchanged from original
    public static class FastScanner {
        protected DataInputStream dataInputStream;
        protected byte[] buffer = new byte[0x10000];
        protected int bufferOffset;
        protected int bufferLength;
        protected boolean isEndOfFile;

        public FastScanner() throws IOException {
            dataInputStream = new DataInputStream(System.in);
            Read();
        }

        protected void Read() throws IOException {
            final int length = dataInputStream.read(buffer);
            if (length > 0) {
                bufferLength = length;
            } else {
                bufferLength = 0;
                isEndOfFile = true;
            }
            bufferOffset = 0;
        }

        protected byte nextByte() throws IOException {
            if (bufferOffset == bufferLength) {
                if (!isEndOfFile) Read();
                if (isEndOfFile) return 0;
            }
            return buffer[bufferOffset++];
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int a = 0;
            boolean isNegative = false;
            byte b = nextByte();
            while (b <= ' ') b = nextByte();
            if (b == '-') {
                isNegative = true;
                b = nextByte();
            }
            while (b > ' ') {
                a = a * 10 + (b - '0');
                b = nextByte();
            }
            return isNegative ? -a : a;
        }
    }
}

public class Task939F {

    private static int N, K, rotates, minRot;
    private static int[] L, R;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        N = fs.nextInt();
        K = fs.nextInt();
        L = new int[K];
        R = new int[K];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            L[i] = fs.nextInt();
            R[i] = fs.nextInt();

        int[] lo = new int[2];
        int[] hi = new int[2];
        rotates = 0;
        minRot = 0;

        dfs(0, lo, hi, 0, 0, false);

            System.out.println(minRot);

            System.out.println("Hungry");
        }

        if (minRot == 0) minRot = x;
        else minRot = Math.min(minRot, x);
    }

    private static void dfs(int side, int[] lo, int[] hi,
                            int off, int idx, boolean inside) {
        if (lo[0] > N || lo[1] > N) return;
        if ((lo[0] <= N && hi[0] >= N) || (lo[1] <= N && hi[1] >= N)) {
            if ((hi[0] < N && side == 1) || (hi[1] < N && side == 0)) {
                save(rotates + 1);
            } else {
                save(rotates);
            }
            return;

        if (idx == K) return;

        if (inside) {
            if (L[idx] == R[idx]) {
                dfs(side, lo, hi, off, idx + 1, false);
                rotates++;
                dfs(1 - side, lo, hi, off, idx + 1, false);
                rotates--;
            } else {
                int d = R[idx] - L[idx];
                // no rotate
                lo[side] += d;
                hi[side] += d;
                dfs(side, lo, hi, R[idx], idx + 1, false);
                lo[side] -= d;
                hi[side] -= d;

                // rotate once
                hi[side] += d;
                hi[1 - side] += d;
                rotates++;
                dfs(1 - side, lo, hi, R[idx], idx + 1, false);
                rotates--;
                hi[side] -= d;
                hi[1 - side] -= d;

                // rotate twice
                hi[side] += d;
                lo[1 - side] += 1;
                hi[1 - side] += d - 1;
                rotates += 2;
                dfs(side, lo, hi, R[idx], idx + 1, false);
                rotates -= 2;
                hi[side] -= d;
                lo[1 - side] -= 1;
                hi[1 - side] -= d - 1;

            int d = L[idx] - off;
            lo[side] += d;
            hi[side] += d;
            dfs(side, lo, hi, L[idx], idx, true);
            lo[side] -= d;
            hi[side] -= d;
